list.name: station
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "manufacturing", tag: "station", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "station_metrics" and r.scenario == "${scenario}")

targets.query:
from(bucket: "manufacturing")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "station_metrics" and r.scenario == "${scenario}" and r._field == "state")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.station =~ /${station:regex}/)

from(bucket: "manufacturing")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "line_metrics" and r.scenario == "${scenario}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "total_wip" or r._field == "total_good" or r._field == "total_scrap")
